discovered_sources.description:
English-Congo Swahili Parallel Dataset
	

This dataset contains parallel sentences in English and Congo Swahili (Democratic Republic of the Congo).

	
		
		Dataset Information
	


Language Pair: English ↔ Congo Swahili
Language Code: swc
Country: Democratic Republic of the Congo
Original Source: OPUS MT560 Dataset


	
		
		Dataset Structure
	

The dataset contains parallel sentences that can be used for:

Machine translation training
Cross-lingual NLP tasks
Language model fine-tuning… Se
